brief: Opens a file to add text at its end, creating it when missing, and keeps everything already there.
detail: Reach for it for logs and any file that only grows: Write, WriteLine, WriteLines and WriteLogEntry add at the end, and the reading methods of stzFileReadingMixin are available too. The folder must exist. The text must be a text: a number given to Write ends the whole Ring process silently today. The class stzFile is another name for it.
receiver:
write("demo_note.txt", "alpha" + char(10) + "beta gamma" + char(10) + "end")
o1 = new stzFileAppender("demo_note.txt")
